mapper.select:
SELECT /*selectMasterMdAmCommonManageList*/ TYPE, CODE, TEXT1, TEXT2, TEXT3, TEXT4, FLAG, VALUE1, ADD_DATE, TEXT5, TEXT6 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M000'
AND CODE LIKE '%' || #{st_code_m} || '%'
AND (( TEXT1 LIKE '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%' OR TEXT1 LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') OR TEXT1 LIKE LOWER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') ) OR ( TEXT2 LIKE '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%' OR TEXT2 LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') OR TEXT2 LIKE LOWER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') ) OR ( TEXT3 LIKE '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%' OR TEXT3 LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') OR TEXT3 LIKE LOWER( '%' || #{st_name_m} || '%') ))
AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO ICOMCOD1 ( TYPE, CODE, TEXT1, TEXT2, TEXT3, TEXT4, FLAG, ADD_DATE, TEXT5, TEXT6 )VALUES ( 'M000', #{CODE}, #{TEXT1}, #{TEXT2}, #{TEXT3}, #{TEXT4}, #{FLAG}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{ADD_DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD'), '', '' )
UPDATE ICOMCOD1 SET TEXT1 = #{TEXT1}, TEXT2 = #{TEXT2}, TEXT3 = #{TEXT3}, TEXT4 = #{TEXT4}, FLAG = #{FLAG} WHERE TYPE = 'M000' AND CODE = #{CODE}
